regions.name: Mã River
regions.quote: Schistura caudofurca is a nemacheilid loach from northern Vietnam, Laos and southern China, described from the Mã River in Vietnam.

regions.name: Red River
regions.quote: The Red River is known as Yuanjiang in China and flows from Yunnan into northern Vietnam, where it's known as Sông Cái.

regions.name: Mengyejiang River
regions.quote: At one locality in the Mengyejiang River, S. caudofurca was collected from a 40 m wide riffle section flowing over rocks and pebbles.
